content: We need to determine SMILES of unknown compound given only description? The prompt says "Analyze the provided organic compound sample in a lab environment". But we have no data provided. We need to possibly request spectra? We have tools to get spectra of the sample at hand (no SMILES needed). So we can call mass_spectrometry_spectra, proton_nmr_spectra, carbon_nmr_spectra, ir_spectra. Use minimal experiments. Probably start with mass spec to get molecular weight and formula. Then maybe NMR to deduce structure. Let's call mass_spectrometry_spectra.
